_about: English text for the PSP save/load screens (PARAM.SFO title/details and the Memory Stick errors), written into the EBOOT by tools/build_savetext.py. UTF-8. Save files stay compatible with the unmodified game: only display strings change; the save identity (game name ULJM05030, save name %04d, DATA.BIN, size, key) is untouched (asserted). Keyed by the pointer slot (va) that points at the Japanese string. source: ps1-save = PS1 save-screen/system strings (logs/system_strings_map.md), ps1-script = PS1 English script, approved = the project's wording, new = new translation (confirm).
approved: Project decision 2026-10-01: save name 'Mega Man Legends' with the PS1 save image option (en_ps1_save; default on). Project decision 2026-09-30: English save text, title 'Rockman DASH', PS1 area names; overflow strings may go to the added data area. 2026-09-30 later: all proposed translations approved as written (no R* markers); 'Underground Ruins' shortened to 'Underground' so every string fits in place. 2026-09-30 later: the save title (slot 0x26335c, the savedata utility's game title) = 'Rockman DASH: Hagane no Boukenshin', the same as the PSP menu name; too long for its place, so it goes to the added data area.

No Memory Stick Duo is inserted.
To save Rockman DASH game data, a Memory Stick Duo

formats.why: Play time in the save details: minutes zero-padded (0:07:34 instead of the original's 0:7:34). Formatting change project decision 2026-09-30. The same sprintf (0x22899C) already handles %04d for the save name, so %02d is supported. In place: 25 bytes in the 26 before ULJM05030 (unchanged).
